source_excerpt: The difference in interest rates offered to applicants from different demographic groups, after controlling for financial risk factors, shall not exceed 50 basis points (0.5%).
The rejection rate disparity between any two demographic groups, after controlling for creditworthiness indicators, shall not exceed 10 percentage points.
Objective to ensure non-discriminatory lending systems based on Gender, sex, or gender identity (1.2, 2.1a); industry default applied for this specific metric.
